company.name: Squarespace
company.shortDescription: Squarespace is a website building and hosting platform that helps users create websites without needing advanced technical skills.
company.description: Squarespace is a website building and e-commerce platform that enables users to build brands and transact with their customers. The company's suite of products helps entrepreneurs, creatives, and professionals manage their projects and businesses through websites, domains, e-commerce, marketing tools, scheduling, and Unfold, tools for managing a social media presence. The firm provides a variety of add-on and independent solutions, including scheduling capabilities, email marketing, member sections for paid content, and design tools for social networking and video content.

productsAndServices.description: A hosted website-building platform with templates, drag-and-drop editing, responsive layouts, content management, security, and analytics for creating and managing websites without coding.

productsAndServices.description: Online appointment and class scheduling software for booking management, calendar synchronization, intake forms, automated reminders, client records, payments, packages, subscriptions, and gift certificates.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,700,000,000 to $10,000,000,000, a 5.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 44 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
